text.title: Internal Link Audit Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the internal-link audit report: a rendered crawl inside the audit period reconciled to the sitemap and CMS counts with every gap over 5 percent explained, per-page incoming counts split into contextual and boilerplate with over-linked hubs flagged, every orphan carrying exactly one decision (rewire with source and anchor, redirect to a target, deindex), a pillar-cluster link matrix per declared cluster with structurally incomplete pillars flagged, anchor-text distributions for rewire targets with generic anchors counted, hygiene findings for links into 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, noindex, foreign-canonical and nofollow targets, a rewire plan whose every item names source, target, anchor, placement, action, owner and due date, and a Search Console baseline per rewire target with a re-measurement date at least 8 weeks after the last due date. Validator at scripts/validate-internal-link-audit.py enforces it, including the reconciliation arithmetic, the matrix-to-plan mapping, the hub and redirect exclusions and the baseline coverage.

required.field: `start` and `end` dates of the audit period

`crawler`, `crawl_date` inside the period, `javascript_rendered` true, `indexable_pages` (HTTP 200, no noindex, self-canonical), `sitemap_urls`, `cms_published_pages`, and `discrepancies[]` with `source`, `gap_pct` and an `explanation` for every gap above 5 percent (r-crawl-scope-reconciled)

`basis` contextual, `pages[]` each with `url`, `contextual_incoming` and `boilerplate_incoming`, and `over_linked_hubs[]` with `url`, `contextual_incoming`, `threshold` (r-incoming-count-excludes-boilerplate)

each `url`, `found_via` (sitemap, analytics, crawl), `contextual_incoming` 0, and exactly one `decision`: rewire with `source_url` and `anchor_text`, redirect with `redirect_target`, or deindex (r-orphan-gets-a-decision)

each `pillar_url`, `cluster_pages[]` with `url`, `links_to_pillar`, `pillar_links_to_it`, `cluster_to_pillar_links` (count of true), `structurally_incomplete` true when that count is below 5; every false edge has a rewire item (r-pillar-cluster-reciprocity)

one entry per rewire target and top-20 page: `url`, `total_links`, `anchors[]` with `anchor`, `count`, `share` = count / total_links, `generic` (click here, read more, this article, raw URL, empty alt) (r-anchor-text-descriptive)
each `source_url`, `current_target`, `final_url`, `issue` from redirect_3xx, client_error_4xx, server_error_5xx, noindex_target, canonical_elsewhere, nofollow (r-link-targets-final-url)

each `source_url`, `target_url` (a final indexable URL, never a hub or a redirecting URL), `anchor_text`, `placement`, `action` add / change_anchor / remove / redirect, `owner`, `due_date` (r-rewire-item-fully-specified)
one entry per rewire target: `url`, `clicks`, `impressions`, `average_position`, `contextual_incoming`, `window_days` 28 ending at the period end (r-pre-post-search-console-baseline)
`date` at least 56 days after the last rewire `due_date`, `metrics` clicks, impressions, average_position (r-pre-post-search-console-baseline)

forbidden.pattern: `crawl.javascript_rendered` false, a `crawl_date` outside the audit period, or a sitemap or CMS gap above 5 percent with no discrepancy entry — partial-crawl-false-orphans
`incoming_counts.basis` other than contextual, or a page row without a separate `boilerplate_incoming` column — boilerplate-inflated-counts
an orphan with `decision` leave, keep or none, a rewire decision without `source_url` and `anchor_text`, or a redirect decision without `redirect_target` — orphan-list-without-decisions
a cluster with fewer than 5 cluster pages linking to the pillar not flagged `structurally_incomplete`, or a false edge in the matrix with no matching rewire item — cluster-on-paper-only
a generic anchor not flagged `generic`, `share` that is not count / total_links, or two or more new links to one target carrying the identical anchor — read-more-anchor-monoculture
a rewire `target_url` that appears as a `current_target` in the hygiene findings, i.e. a link added to a redirecting, erroring, noindex or foreign-canonical URL — links-into-redirects-and-nofollow
a rewire item with `placement` shorter than a sentence, no `owner`, no `due_date`, or a `target_url` listed under `over_linked_hubs` (r-rewire-item-fully-specified)
a rewire target with no `gsc_baseline` entry, a window other than 28 days, or a `remeasurement.date` earlier than 8 weeks after the last due date (r-pre-post-search-console-baseline)

example.note: Crawl on 2026-08-20 is inside the period; 412 vs 430 sitemap URLs is a 4.2 percent gap and needs no entry, 412 vs 445 CMS pages is 7.4 percent and is explained; the two false edges in the matrix and the rewire-decision orphan each have a plan item; no plan item targets the /blog hub or the redirecting old DMARC post; every rewire target has a baseline and the re-measurement is 61 days after the last due date.

Crawl without JavaScript rendering, dated three months before the period, 250 pages against a 430-URL sitemap with no discrepancy explained; counts on the total basis with boilerplate folded into the contextual column; an orphan left as is and a rewire decision without source or anchor; three of five cluster pages link to the pillar yet the cluster is not flagged incomplete; "read more" and a raw URL not flagged generic; a plan item with action "strengthen", placement "somewhere", owner "team", anchor "read more", targeting the /blog hub, and another targeting a URL the hygiene findings show redirects; a 90-day baseline window and a re-measurement five days after the due date with one metric.

list.item: `crawl.crawl_date` lies inside `audit_period`, `javascript_rendered` is true, and every sitemap or CMS gap above 5 percent has a `discrepancies[]` entry whose `gap_pct` matches the arithmetic.
`incoming_counts.basis` is contextual and every page row carries `boilerplate_incoming` separately; hubs above the threshold are listed.
Every orphan has one of rewire, redirect, deindex; a rewire orphan names `source_url` and `anchor_text` and has a matching `rewire_plan` item.
Per cluster, `cluster_to_pillar_links` is the count of `links_to_pillar` true, `structurally_incomplete` is true below 5, and every false edge maps to a `rewire_plan` add item.
Every rewire target has an `anchor_text` entry with shares that sum from count / total_links, generic anchors flagged, and new links to one target do not share one identical anchor.
No `rewire_plan.target_url` is a `hygiene_findings.current_target` or an `over_linked_hubs.url`; every item has a person as `owner` and a `due_date`.
Every rewire target has a 28-day `gsc_baseline` row and `remeasurement.date` is at least 56 days after the last `due_date`.

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field rules (period and reconciliation arithmetic, orphan-to-plan and matrix-to-plan mapping, anchor share arithmetic and monoculture, hub and redirect exclusions, baseline coverage and the 8-week re-measurement).
